questions.text: A group of students are seated in a line facing North. In the coded language used by their teacher, 'CLOUD' is written as 'DMPVE'. If the word 'STORM' is written using the same logic, which of the following will be its code?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Observe the pattern in 'CLOUD' -> 'DMPVE'. Each letter shifts forward by +1 position (C->D, L->M, O->P, U->V, D->E). Applying this +1 shift to 'STORM': S+1=T, T+1=U, O+1=P, R+1=S, M+1=N. Result is 'TUPSN'. Step-by-step: S(19)->20(T), T(20)->21(U), O(15)->16(P), R(18)->19(S), M(13)->14(N). The code for STORM is TUPSN. Option A matches.

questions.text: Pointing to a woman in a photograph, a man says, 'She is the mother of the only daughter of my son.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Work backwards from the speaker. 'My son's only daughter' is the granddaughter. The 'mother of the granddaughter' is the son's wife, i.e., Daughter-in-law. Step-by-step: 1) Speaker's Son. 2) Son's only daughter = Speaker's Granddaughter. 3) Mother of Granddaughter = Son's Wife. 4) Son's Wife = Speaker's Daughter-in-law.

questions.text: What is the largest planet in our solar system in terms of mass?
questions.solution: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system in terms of mass, with a mass approximately 318 times that of Earth.

questions.text: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the 'Right to Constitutional Remedies' enshrined?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar called Article 32 the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'. Remember '32' for 'Remedy/Teeth' to the Fundamental Rights. Full Solution: Article 32 provides the right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights. It empowers the Supreme Court to issue directions, orders, or writs (Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Quo Warranto, Certiorari). Article 226 grants similar power to High Courts. Article 14 is Equality before Law, Article 19 is Freedom of Speech etc., Article 21 is Protection of Life and Personal Liberty.

questions.text: How many Schedules are there in the Constitution of India?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use elimination based on amendment history. The original Constitution had 8 Schedules. Four were added later: 9th (1951), 10th (1985), 11th (1992), 12th (1992). Total = 8 + 4 = 12. Full Solution: The Constitution of India originally contained 8 Schedules. Through various Constitutional Amendment Acts, four more Schedules were added: the 9th Schedule (Land Reforms), 10th Schedule (Anti-Defection Law), 11th Schedule (Powers of Panchayats), and 12th Schedule (Powers of Municipalities). No further Schedules have been added since 1992, making the current total 12.

questions.text: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to its frequent flooding and shifting course?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Associate 'Sorrow' with high sediment load and flooding in North Bihar plains. Kosi is infamous for breaching embankments. Full Solution: The Kosi River carries a massive amount of silt from the Himalayas, causing its bed to rise and the river to frequently change course (avulsion). This leads to devastating floods in the plains of North Bihar almost every year, earning it the sobriquet 'Sorrow of Bihar'. The Damodar River was formerly called 'Sorrow of Bengal' (now controlled by DVC dams).

questions.text: Which of the following Indian states has the largest geographical area?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate using relative size comparison. Rajasthan (342,239 km²) is clearly larger than Madhya Pradesh (308,252 km²) and Maharashtra (307,713 km²), which are close to each other but smaller. Uttar Pradesh (240,928 km²) is significantly smaller. Full Solution: Rajasthan is the largest state in India by area, covering approximately 342,239 square kilometers. It is followed by Madhya Pradesh (approx. 308,252 km²) and Maharashtra (approx. 307,713 km²), which are very close in size. Uttar Pradesh ranks fourth in area (approx. 240,928 km²) but is the most populous state.

questions.text: If a : b = 3 : 4 and b : c = 5 : 6, then a : c is equal to
questions.solution: Shortcut: Multiply the two ratios: a/c = (a/b) × (b/c) = (3/4) × (5/6) = 15/24 = 5/8 → a : c = 5 : 8. Full: Make b common. a:b = 3:4 = 15:20 (multiply by 5). b:c = 5:6 = 20:24 (multiply by 4). Hence a:b:c = 15:20:24 → a:c = 15:24 = 5:8.

questions.text: A wire of resistance R is stretched uniformly until its length becomes double the original length. Assuming the volume and resistivity remain constant, what is the new resistance of the wire?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For a wire of constant volume and resistivity, Resistance (R) is directly proportional to the square of Length (L). Since Length doubles (2L), Resistance becomes 2² = 4 times the original (4R). Step-by-step: Resistance formula R = ρL/A. Volume V = A × L = constant. New Length L' = 2L. New Area A' = V/L' = (A×L)/(2L) = A/2. New Resistance R' = ρL'/A' = ρ(2L) / (A/2) = 4(ρL/A) = 4R.

questions.text: What is the unit digit of (7^2023 + 3^2024)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use cyclicity of unit digits. 7 has cycle 4 (7,9,3,1); 2023 mod 4 = 3 → unit digit 3. 3 has cycle 4 (3,9,7,1); 2024 mod 4 = 0 → unit digit 1. Sum = 3+1 = 4. Full: 7^1=7, 7^2=49→9, 7^3=343→3, 7^4=2401→1 repeats every 4. 2023 = 4×505+3 → unit digit of 7^2023 = 3. 3^1=3, 3^2=9, 3^3=27→7, 3^4=81→1 repeats every 4. 2024 = 4×506 → unit digit of 3^2024 = 1. 3+1=4.

questions.text: In a grassland food chain (Grass → Grasshopper → Frog → Snake), the energy available at the producer level (Grass) is 10,000 J. Applying the 10% law of energy transfer, what is the energy available to the secondary consumer (Frog)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Energy transfers twice (Producer → Primary → Secondary). Apply 10% twice: 10,000 × 0.1 × 0.1 = 100 J. Step-by-step: Energy at Producer = 10,000 J. Energy at Primary Consumer (Grasshopper) = 10% of 10,000 = 1,000 J. Energy at Secondary Consumer (Frog) = 10% of 1,000 = 100 J.

questions.text: Find the missing term in the following series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Recognize the pattern n × (n+1): 1×2=2, 2×3=6, 3×4=12, 4×5=20, 5×6=30. Next term is 6×7=42. Full Method: Calculate differences between consecutive terms: 4, 6, 8, 10. Differences increase by 2 each time. Next difference is 12. Add 12 to the last term 30 to get 42.

questions.text: Find the smallest positive integer n such that the 10‑digit number 123456789n is divisible by 11.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Divisibility by 11 → difference between sum of digits in odd positions and even positions must be 0 or multiple of 11. For 123456789: odd positions (1,3,5,7,9) sum = 1+3+5+7+9 = 25; even positions (2,4,6,8) sum = 2+4+6+8 = 20. Difference = 5. Adding n at position 10 (even) makes even sum = 20+n. New difference = 25 − (20+n) = 5−n. For divisibility, 5−n = 0 ⇒ n = 5. Full: Check n=5 gives difference 0, so 1234567895 is divisible by 11.

questions.text: A shopkeeper marks his goods 40% above cost price and then allows a discount of 10%. What is his effective profit percent?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Successive percentage change formula: net% = a + b + ab/100, where a = +40% (markup), b = −10% (discount). Net = 40 − 10 + (40×−10)/100 = 30 − 4 = 26%. Full: Let CP = 100. MP = 140. SP after 10% discount = 140 × 0.9 = 126. Profit = 26 → Profit% = 26%.

Shortcut (Elimination Technique): Vitamin B12 deficiency causes Pernicious Anemia/Neurological issues. Vitamin C deficiency causes Scurvy. Vitamin D deficiency causes Rickets/Osteomalacia. Vitamin A is the only one directly linked to Rhodopsin (visual pigment) synthesis and retinal health. Step-by-step: Vitamin A (Retinol) is a critical component of Rhodopsin, the photopigment in rod cells of the retina responsible for vision in low-light conditions. A deficiency impairs the regeneration of rhodopsin, leading to Nyctalopia (Night Blindness). It is also the leading cause of preventable childhood blindness (Xerophthalmia).
